_comment: MOSS-Image (SFT) - Text to Image. Export (API) format for a bitGen Studio image style.
2.566.0 (Tim: "can you add this model type to bitgen please...https://huggingface.co/Comfy-Org/MOSS-Image, add an
option in add-ons to download and install it"). OpenMOSS's open 5B image model (Apache-2.0), repackaged for ComfyUI.
Derived from ComfyUI's own template (Comfy-Org/workflow_templates: templates/image_moss_image_t2i.json): node types, widget names and
values taken from that file; its subgraph flattened (what Export (API) gives). Its prompt upsampler (TextGenerate)
and its switches are left out: bitGen Studio's own prompt tools (✨ / the LLM) do that job.
MODELS (ComfyUI's OWN folders; Comfy-Org/MOSS-Image on Hugging Face - Settings ▸ Add-ons ▸ MOSS-Image downloads them):
models/diffusion_models/moss_image_sft_int8_convrot.safetensors  (5.4 GB; the _bf16 build beside it = higher precision, more VRAM)
Needs ComfyUI with MOSS-Image support (16 Oct 2026 or later - the moss_image text encoder type).
25 steps, cfg 2.5, er_sde / simple, skip layer guidance on layer 22 (0 - 50 %) - the template's settings (the official
pipeline: 50 steps, cfg 3). About 1 MP (trained 1-2 MP, works 0.25 - 4 MP), sides a multiple of 16. Do not add a
shift node (its default 5 is built in). LoRAs: model-only (LoraLoaderModelOnly), 4 slots, bypassed when empty.
